Who’s eligible for the Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) campaign?
Can I redeem my funds?
As Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) is a flexible product, you can redeem your funds anytime after subscription. You can redeem from either the campaign landing page or under Assets > Earn.

When the campaign ends, if you haven’t redeemed manually, we’ll automatically reinvest eligible crypto (such as USDT, OKB, and many others) into Simple Earn. Any unsupported crypto will be returned to your Funding account within 2 hours.
What rewards will I receive?
You’ll receive two types of rewards:
(1) an airdrop of a newly-listed token (principal-protected), and
(2) a base reward in your subscription crypto that’s generated with Simple Earn.
Learn more about
How are rewards calculated?
Rewards are calculated hourly.
Simple Earn rewards begin in the second hour after your funds are lent out. If not lent out, no rewards are generated.
Airdrop rewards for newly listed tokens also begin up to 2 hours after subscription.
If you redeem your funds within one hour after subscription, you won’t earn any rewards for that hour.
When are rewards distributed?
Rewards are distributed hourly. Rewards from a one-hour period will be distributed in the following hour after calculations are completed.
For example, rewards for the time period of 3:00 UTC to 4:00 UTC will be sometime between 4:00 and 5:00 UTC.

Eligible Deposits: Qualifying deposits include on-chain deposits, credit/debit card transactions, third-party payments, and P2P transactions. Internal transfers are excluded. Deposit amounts are calculated based on their USDT-equivalent value recognized by the campaign system.

Trading Volume Calculation: Qualifying trading volume includes executed opening and closing trades in designated USDT-Margined Perpetual Futures. Trading volume generated using trial funds will not count. Exclusive TradFi tasks only include the five designated trading pairs listed above. No qualifying trading volume can be generated during market closures, trading suspensions, or temporary delistings.

Task Calculation: Daily tasks are calculated by calendar day (UTC+8), with a maximum of one draw entry per day and 14 draw entries throughout the campaign. Tiered trading tasks are based on cumulative qualifying trading volume during the campaign. Each tier can be claimed separately, and rewards are cumulative. The cumulative TradFi trading task awards three draw entries upon reaching 50,000 USDT and can be claimed only once during the campaign.

Draw Rules: Each gacha draw consumes one draw entry, and prizes are awarded randomly. Meeting the deposit requirement does not guarantee a Rolex or any other specific prize. Draw entries are non-transferable, cannot be exchanged for cash, and must be used before the campaign ends.

Account Restrictions: Each user may participate using only one main account. Related accounts are not eligible for duplicate rewards. Sub-accounts, market makers, brokers, institutional accounts, and API accounts are excluded.

Fair Participation: Bulk registrations, fraudulent deposits, wash trading, self-trading, and other abusive activities are strictly prohibited. XT reserves the right to disqualify participants and revoke or reclaim improperly obtained rewards if suspicious or fraudulent activity is detected.

Additional Conditions: Prize availability and remaining draw entries are subject to the information displayed on the campaign page. XT reserves the right to address abnormal participation and campaign disputes in accordance with applicable rules.
